:= by
  haveI : IsKilling R L := LieAlgebra.IsKilling.killingForm_nondegenerate R L
  let ad_range : LieIdeal R L := (LieDerivation.ad R L).range
  haveI : IsLieAbelian ↥ad_range → ad_range = ⊥ :=
    LieAlgebra.IsKilling.ideal_eq_bot_of_isLieAbelian R L
  haveI : Nondegenerate (killingForm R L) :=
    LieAlgebra.IsKilling.killingForm_nondegenerate R L
  haveI : Nondegenerate (killingForm R ad_range) :=
    (LieAlgebra.IsKilling.killingForm_nondegenerate R ad_range).2
  exact LieAlgebra.IsKilling.of_nondegenerate R ad_range (killingForm R ad_range) this
